summary_ja: トレーディング勘定を設ける最終指定親会社等に対し、あらかじめ金融庁長官への届出を義務付け、バンキング勘定分類商品や勘定間振替方針等を添付書類として提出させ、変更があれば遅滞なく変更届出を求める条文。
summary_en: Requires Ultimate Designated Parent Companies, etc. establishing trading accounts to notify the FSA Commissioner in advance with supporting documents on banking account products and transfer policies, and to file amended notifications without delay when these matters change.
